messages:
deploy-bot: Starting canary for v3.15 in us-central. Change window 2026-03-22 02:00-03:00 UTC. Group size=4. Release notes: https://internal.redwood.dev/releases/v3.15
tara: Please paste the backout/runbook link and who is rollback owner. Also any emergency pin command?
nate: Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.dev/display/OPS/Backout-v3.15. I'll own rollback. Emergency pin: `rdeploy pin --cluster canary --image redwood:v3.14 --reason "rollback" --duration 60m`
sre-bot: Alert thresholds set by tara: p95 >180ms for 3m OR 5xxs >0.8% for 2m. Will auto-pause.
tara: Confirm DB migrations are toggle-safe on canary (ff/pgm/enable_new_index=false). Nate, add quick checklist here please.
nate: Short rollback checklist:
1) `rdeploy rollback --to-tag redwood:v3.14 --cluster canary`
2) Restart ingress if stuck: `k rollout restart deployment/ingress -n redwood`
3) Clear kv cache: `redis-cli -h cache.canary FLUSHALL`
4) Check worker logs for schema errors: `kubectl logs -n redwood -l app=worker | grep -i schema`
5) Post status in thread and notify product for release note updates.
deploy-bot: Canary progress: 1/4 OK, 2/4 degraded (p95=210ms) -> auto-paused by rule.
tara: Auto-pause seen. Nate, execute rollback now.
nate: Rolling back to v3.14.
sre-bot: Rollback completed. Health checks passing: p95=88ms, error-rate=0.1%. Recommend 15m watch before reattempt.
product-bot: Product team preparing a rollback note; will update release page.
tara: Thanks all. Please add incident ticket and short postmortem after watch window.
